mapper.sql: SELECT s.id FROM product_sku s WHERE s.spu_id=#{spuId}
mapper.select:
SELECT p.* FROM product_spu p WHERE p.deleted = FALSE
AND (p.spu_code ILIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.keyword},'%') OR p.name ILIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.keyword},'%') OR p.alias ILIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.keyword},'%') OR p.mnemonic_code ILIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.keyword},'%') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_sku s WHERE s.spu_id=p.id AND s.deleted=FALSE AND (s.sku_code ILIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.keyword},'%') OR s.barcode ILIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.keyword},'%'))))
AND p.category_id IN #{id}
AND p.status=#{query.status} AND p.master_status=#{query.masterStatus} AND p.storage_method=#{query.storageMethod}
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_tag_relation r WHERE r.spu_id=p.id AND r.deleted=FALSE AND r.tag_id IN #{tagId})
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_image i WHERE i.spu_id=p.id AND i.deleted=FALSE AND i.is_primary=TRUE)
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_image i WHERE i.spu_id=p.id AND i.deleted=FALSE AND i.is_primary=TRUE)
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_sku s WHERE s.spu_id=p.id AND s.deleted=FALSE AND s.barcode IS NOT NULL AND s.barcode <> '')
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_sku s WHERE s.spu_id=p.id AND s.deleted=FALSE AND s.barcode IS NOT NULL AND s.barcode <> '')
AND p.created_at >= #{query.createdFrom} AND p.created_at <= #{query.createdTo}
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_sku s WHERE s.spu_id=p.id AND s.deleted=FALSE AND s.status=#{query.skuStatus} AND s.product_type=#{query.productType})
